info.name: FLOW - Permissions Full
info.description:
Complete RBAC testing: 2 Keycloak users (USER role) + permissions + roles on real entities.

User1 (viewer): VIEW on DATA_FABRIC + DATA_SOURCE
User2 (admin): EDIT on DATA_FABRIC + ADMIN on SCHEMA + EDIT on DATA_SOURCE

Verifies: exists=true/false per user per entity, permission_by_userid, role-permission exists.

Requires: DB config + kc_admin_user + kc_admin_password + keycloak_admin_url in environment.

exec: // Skip token refresh if using admin token (e.g. for tenant delete)
(e,res)=>{ if(e||res.code!==200){ throw new Error('token fetch failed: '+(e||res.status)); }
// 5xx is a real server failure — register a failing assertion so it can't pass silently.
// EXCEPT endpoints whose 5xx is a known tenant/infra-config gap (surfaced by the step's own
// assertion instead), so one backend gap doesn't cascade into dozens of identical failures:
//   synapse namespace status/stats -> 500 when the tenant has no QuipuSynapse URL configured
//   test-connection/sample-records  -> 500 when called without a persisted datasource id
if(code>=500 && !soft5xx){ pm.test('[api] server '+code+' @ '+pm.info.requestName+' :: '+msg, () => { throw new Error(code+' '+msg); }); }
console.log('Setup: state cleared for env=' + pm.environment.get('env_name'));

pm.test('01a Create DS 2xx', () => { if(![200,201].includes(code)){pm.collectionVariables.set('_flow_failed','true');pm.collectionVariables.set('_flow_failed_at','01a Create DS');} pm.expect(code).to.be.oneOf([200,201]); });

pm.test('01b Create schema 2xx', () => { if(![200,201].includes(code)){pm.collectionVariables.set('_flow_failed','true');pm.collectionVariables.set('_flow_failed_at','01b Create Schema');} pm.expect(code).to.be.oneOf([200,201]); });

pm.test('01c Create realm 2xx', () => { if(![200,201].includes(code)){pm.collectionVariables.set('_flow_failed','true');pm.collectionVariables.set('_flow_failed_at','01c Create Realm');} pm.expect(code).to.be.oneOf([200,201]); });
